_doc: OID Mac mini desk jobs (MINI-MIGRATION-PLAN.md). Every job ships DISABLED: install.sh renders plists into <root>/launchd/ and writes <root>/flags/<job>.disabled; only `oidctl enable <job>` copies a plist into ~/Library/LaunchAgents and bootstraps it. cwd = <root>/desk (same relative layout as the box desk). kind: daemon (KeepAlive unless clean exit) | interval (StartInterval seconds). secrets = files under <secrets_dir> exported as env vars of the same name. heartbeat = desk-relative file whose mtime proves the job is alive; ttl by session (rth/ext/closed seconds, null = not checked).

data-api.desc: Read-only feed API :8788 (+ POST /v1/desk-state with write token)

status.desc: Mini source status + alarm -> market-data/latest/mini-status.json, served as /v1/status

option-subs.desc: 5s mini_poller against the local collector: cache/mini-quotes.json, OPRA subs declare, cache/mini-option-quotes.json

marks.desc: SIP quotes + Alpaca snapshot prev-close -> live_refresh.py --equity-quotes-file --options-from-mini --skip-rebuild (rh-quotes, marks, tape, support map)

fa-focus.desc: 5s spot-vs-wall focus watch + in-process fa_focus_refresh (FA key via desk/secrets/flashalpha-api-key symlink)

uw-refresh.desc: UW market tide / net premium / flow alerts every 240s RTH

edgar.desc: SEC EDGAR submissions JSON (Form 4 / 8-K / 10-Q / 10-K) for the desk universe; needs config sec_user_agent

macro-public.desc: FRED HY/IG OAS, DGS10/30, WTI/Brent daily; EIA WPSR (if key); VIX via pluggable provider (default agent_rh)

publish.desc: rebuild + here.now publish every 5 min, all sessions (Phase 5 only: single publisher)

short-borrow.desc: S5 daily append-only archive: UW borrow fee + shares available (desk universe) + FINRA short interest by settlement date -> data/short-borrow/

alerts.desc: Push alarm-state changes (stale/down/failed/recovered) from mini-status.json to the OID alert webhook; 2-check debounce, 30-min repeat suppression

benzinga.hold: Owned by X Summarizer. Do not enable until X Summarizer agrees (hook only; code is not shipped in this package).

selfheal.desc: local self-heal: kickstart stale-but-alive daemons / silent collector, max 3 per 30 min

vix-live.desc: real-time VIX from FlashAlpha /stockquote/VIX every 120 s (RTH/ext); FRED/Cboe stay labelled fallbacks

position-trigger.desc: paper/live position guard: INVALIDATE / WALL_BREAK / LOSS_BACKSTOP / GIVEBACK -> webhook + flag file. NEVER trades

futures-live.desc: real WTI/Brent front-month futures (FlashAlpha CL=F/BZ=F, one call/min alternating, quota guard <300) -> futures-quotes.json for the live page

fa-walls.desc: live FlashAlpha walls (/v1/flow/levels) for the private live page, 10 min core + 40 min rotation, 6:30 AM-1 PM PT weekdays, quota guard -> ~/oid-live-page/data/fa-walls-pulse.json

hal-exit-watch.desc: Hal fast exit watcher: every 3 s in RTH (+15 min) checks paper-trades/hal-live/active-exit-rules.json seats (option stop/target/+20% half, stock stop/target, 5m structure, time stop, 12:40 PT DTE<=8 warning) -> Hal webhook (HAL_EXIT_WEBHOOK_URL/KEY files, hot-loaded; dry-run until present). NEVER TRADES

host-monitor.desc: Host resource logger: every 15 s weekdays 6:00-13:30 PT, 5 min otherwise -> ~/oid-data/host/host-YYYYMMDD.jsonl + cache/host-health.json (load, CPU, memory, swap, disk, net, top 8 procs). Read-only.
